item.title: Refactor orders crate status String to OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated, local socket): The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals all over the code. Refactor it to a proper type.

Requirements:
- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns the lowercase names ("pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"); `Display` prints the same.
- `FromStr` for `OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`, a public error type that implements `std::error::Error` and whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled; nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`; re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root; use the enum everywhere, so the status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Constraints:
- Observable behaviour (errors, report output and ordering, parsing) must stay exactly the same. First characterize the current behaviour (including how existing code parses, case handling, and report ordering) and keep it identical.
- Where the old code compared strings for transitions or ordering, preserve those semantics exactly; do not add new behaviour.
- `cargo test` must pass.
- Commit the work on the local branch (ship mode is local). Do not push. Do not set git identity overrides.
- Follow the repository's CLAUDE.md / project conventions if present; keep functions short and avoid comments that merely restate code.

stages.summary:
Baseline and characterization for "Refactor orders crate status String to OrderStatus enum" (attempt 1, no prior feedback).

Commits (branch archon/qmmfgta8-refactor-orders-crate-status-string-to-o, local, not pushed):
- Original baseline: 0bccc797355d3aec1362d7eb630a6786373d215f ("bench fixture"). Production code, existing tests/orders.rs, and Cargo files are unchanged from it.
- Characterization: 43e72f3 "test: characterize order status lifecycle, parsing and report ordering". It adds only tests/characterization.rs (18 tests, public API only). No production code or existing test was changed.
- Final tree: e27c7dd949ae22dba1ff27274abf66e049ac8a69. Worktree is clean.

Structural goal (from brief): add src/status.rs with OrderStatus {Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled}, as_str/Display (lowercase), FromStr with ParseStatusError, can_transition_to; Order::status becomes OrderStatus; re-export from the root; status literals only in status.rs.

Checks (no README, Makefile or CI exists; discovered cargo test/clippy/fmt; toolchain cargo 1.98.1):
- Before (0bccc79): cargo test: pass, 3 tests. cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings: pass. cargo fmt --check: FAIL, pre-existing diffs in src/billing.rs, src/order.rs, src/report.rs, src/shipping.rs and tests/orders.rs. Left unchanged.
- After (43e72f3): cargo test: pass, 21 tests (3 existing + 18 new). clippy: pass. fmt --check: same pre-existing failures. tests/characterization.rs is rustfmt-clean.
- Mutation check: three injected faults (is_open drops paid; status_counts reversed; from_line trim removed) each failed a new test. Sources were restored with git checkout.
- All builds used CARGO_TARGET_DIR in the item cache.

Public-surface inventory that must stay the same:
- Root: pub mod billing/order/report/shipping; pub use order::Order.
- Order: pub fields id:u32, customer:String, total_cents:u64, status:String (the status type is the one allowed change). Derives Debug, Clone, PartialEq. Order::new(u32,&str,u64) starts pending. is_open() is true for pending or paid only. cancel() -> Result<(),String> is refused from shipped/cancelled.
- billing::pay(&mut Order) -> Result<(),String>: only from pending. billing::outstanding_cents(&[Order]) -> u64: sums pending totals only.
- shipping::ship(&mut Order) -> Result<(),String>: only from paid. shipping::ready_to_ship(&[Order]) -> Vec<u32>: paid ids in input order.
- report::status_counts(&[Order]) -> Vec<(String,usize)>: sorted by status name (lexicographic: cancelled, paid, pending, shipped), not lifecycle order. report::to_line(&Order) -> "id,customer,total,status". report::from_line(&str) -> Result<Order,String>.
- Error strings (exact): "order {id} cannot be paid: it is {status}"; "order {id} cannot be shipped: it is {status}"; "order {id} cannot be cancelled: it is {status}"; "expected 4 fields, got {n}"; "bad id {:?}: {parse err}"; "bad total {:?}: {parse err}"; "unknown status {:?}".
- from_line semantics: trims the whole line only. Splits on ','. Checks field count first, then id (u32), then total (u64), then status. Status match is case-sensitive and does not trim inner whitespace. Customer is kept verbatim (empty allowed). A leading '+' on numbers is accepted.
- Failed transitions leave the status unchanged.
- Allowed exception: Order::status type changes String -> OrderStatus. The brief does not explicitly allow other signature changes (e.g. status_counts returning OrderStatus). The new tests compare via to_string(), so they pass for either choice. If the refactorer changes status_counts, it must keep alphabetical-by-name ordering, not derive(Ord) declaration order.

Coverage: The existing tests cover the basic lifecycle, cancel refused from shipped, pay refused from cancelled, ship refused from pending, status_counts without shipped, a single outstanding total, a single ready_to_ship id, to_line/from_line round trip for paid, and an "is_err" check on lost. The new tests cover the full pay/ship/cancel x4-state matrix with exact messages and no-mutation on refusal; is_open for all four; counts ordering including shipped; input order for ready_to_ship; to_line and round trip for all four statuses; from_line trim, customer text, status rejections (case, spaces, empty, unknown), field-count-before-value, id-then-total-then-status order, and exact numeric parse errors.

Known gaps (not pinned): outstanding_cents u64 overflow (debug panic) has no test. No tests exist for Display, as_str, FromStr or can_transition_to (new behaviour, out of baseline scope). Customers containing a comma don't round-trip (not tested). Test files contain status literals; the brief's "literals only in status.rs" rule needs a decision on whether tests are included. Existing fmt failures are pre-existing and were not reformatted.

Feedback: none on attempt 1.

Running processes: none started. No servers to stop.

stages.summary:
Refactored the orders crate so order status is an OrderStatus enum instead of a String. Two commits on archon/qmmfgta8-refactor-orders-crate-status-string-to-o, not pushed: 78f271f adds src/status.rs (enum with as_str/Display, FromStr with ParseStatusError, can_transition_to) and re-exports both from the root; 208c900 switches Order::status to OrderStatus and routes pay, ship and cancel through a shared Order::transition_to. Tree ae3adbe6641decb186890ab5b2046221ab8d63de, worktree clean.

Verification: cargo test passes with 24 tests (3 new unit tests in status.rs, the 18 characterization tests and the 3 existing tests, all unmodified). cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings passes. cargo fmt --check still fails on pre-existing lines in report.rs (to_line, from_line id/total) and tests/orders.rs:40; the baseline diffs in billing.rs, order.rs and shipping.rs are gone only because I rewrote those lines. Status literals now appear only in src/status.rs within src/. A mutation of one lifecycle edge is caught by the new unit test.

Public surface: unchanged except Order::status (String -> OrderStatus, permitted by the brief). status_counts keeps its String signature and name-sorted output; error texts and from_line behaviour are identical per the characterization tests. Pre-existing test files and Cargo files are unchanged.

Assumptions and limits: "literals only in status.rs" is read as applying to src/ (tests/ still contain literals). I added no assert! calls to the refactored functions: they are trivial with typed inputs, and asserts could add panic paths. The outstanding_cents overflow path stays untested. Risk is rated high because Order::status is a public field whose type changed, even though behaviour is preserved. No services were started, so nothing is left running.

pr.body: Approach: new private module src/status.rs with OrderStatus {Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled} (Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash), as_str (lowercase names), Display via as_str, FromStr (exact, case-sensitive) with ParseStatusError (message: unknown status {input:?}), and can_transition_to (pending->paid/cancelled, paid->shipped/cancelled). Re-exported from the root. Order::status is OrderStatus. Order::transition_to(next) (pub(crate)) is shared by cancel, billing::pay and shipping::ship; its error reads 'order {id} cannot be {next}: it is {current}', identical to the old text. report::from_line parses status via FromStr, error text unchanged. status_counts still returns Vec<(String,usize)> and sorts by name via BTreeMap<&str>. Checks: cargo test 24 pass; clippy -D warnings pass; mutation check caught by unit test. cargo fmt --check: pre-existing diffs remain in report.rs (to_line, from_line id/total lines) and tests/orders.rs; the baseline diffs in billing.rs, order.rs and shipping.rs are gone only because those lines were rewritten. Assumptions: 'literals only in status.rs' applies to src/; tests/ still contain literals and are characterization/pre-existing. Open: outstanding_cents overflow untested; FromStr is case-sensitive by design.
pr.summary: Order status is a typed enum. Now: OrderStatus owns names, parsing and lifecycle rules; transitions go through one check. Before: String status compared against literals in 4 modules. Now: literals only in src/status.rs; observable behaviour unchanged (18 characterization tests unchanged and passing).
pr.title: refactor: store order status as OrderStatus enum

risk.why: Public field Order::status changes type String -> OrderStatus, which breaks any external caller comparing it as a string (brief-authorised, but an API break). Touches src/order.rs, billing.rs, shipping.rs, report.rs and lib.rs. Observable behaviour is unchanged: 18 characterization tests and 3 existing tests pass unmodified. Picked high because of the public field type change under the when-in-doubt rule.

Verified HEAD 208c900 (tree ae3adbe6) against baseline 0bccc79 and characterization commit 43e72f3. Worktree is clean, no stash entries, and no processes were started that remain running.

Checks run: cargo test passes after a fresh compile of orders (3 unit, 18 characterization, 3 existing, 0 doctests). Clippy with -D warnings, cargo build --release and cargo doc --no-deps all pass. cargo fmt --check fails at HEAD on src/report.rs:17 and src/report.rs:25 (both pre-existing unformatted lines) and tests/orders.rs:40. The baseline also fails, on billing.rs:2, order.rs:23, report.rs:15, report.rs:23, shipping.rs:2 and tests/orders.rs:40. HEAD adds no new violation, but fmt is not proven clean.

Test modifications: tests/orders.rs, Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock are byte-identical to baseline. tests/characterization.rs is byte-identical to 43e72f3 and passes 18/18 unchanged, including against the original baseline source. No test was removed, skipped or weakened.

Public surface: compile probes of all inventoried signatures and Order fields match between baseline and HEAD. The only differences are the allowed Order::status type change (let s: String = o.status fails with E0308 at HEAD) and the additive root exports OrderStatus and ParseStatusError. Debug of Order now prints status: Pending instead of "pending", a consequence of the allowed change.

Behaviour probe: the same probe source built against each tree produces identical output (74 lines, cmp-equal). It covers the full pay/ship/cancel x4-state matrix with results, states and is_open; 52 from_line inputs; round trips; status_counts; outstanding_cents; ready_to_ship; and the outstanding_cents u64 overflow panic, which is identical on both trees.

Mutation: dropping the Paid->Cancelled edge in a throwaway copy of HEAD makes the unit test only_the_lifecycle_edges_are_allowed and the characterization test cancel_succeeds_from_pending_and_paid_only fail. An earlier stale-cache run was discarded and rebuilt after cargo clean -p orders.

Non-blocking notes: the fmt gap above; the Debug output change; the status literal rule was read as src/ only (tests/ still contains literals, to be confirmed by the operator); no assert! calls were added per the user CLAUDE.md; and two pre-existing gaps, the u64 overflow panic and comma-containing customers not round-tripping, both identical at baseline.

Artifacts: published verify-evidence (out-base.txt, out-head.txt, probe-src/*.rs). Throwaway probes removed from the cache. Build outputs remain in the item cargo-target, which Archon deletes.

VERDICT: PASS
